# What to Cook Tonight Skill

This skill helps you decide what to cook tonight from food you already have. You list what is in your fridge, your time, how many people are eating, and any allergies. It asks for anything missing once, then gives one simple main recipe, with clear steps, pantry basics, and one or two swaps if something is missing.

General public skill, in plain language. No technical skill needed, no code, no account, no app to set up. You just talk: you say what is in your fridge, and you get one simple dinner.
